title: packera dimorphophylla var. intermedia
intro: Packera dimorphophylla var. intermedia, commonly known as a variant of the Alpine Ragwort or Rocky Mountain Ragwort, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion-like flowering plants in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Packera dimorphophylla var. intermedia include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which may help reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
